a.lede: PARTNER CONTENT: AI agents are making security vulnerabilities easier to find and exploit in your code. Software engineering and application security teams need new ways to find and fix them
a.title: Has AI’s ‘Black October’ changed the way you secure your code?

b.lede: The FBI is warning that hackers are using an AI-powered penetration testing framework called ARTEX to automate cyberattacks against organizations worldwide, including a recent ConnectWise supply-chain breach that compromised Microsoft 365 customer environments. [...]
b.title: FBI warns ARTEX AI hacking tool is powering global cyberattacks
